sources.title: Cinzia Casagrande and Stéphane Druel, Locally unsplit families of rational curves of large anticanonical degree on Fano manifolds
sources.inspection: Full 45-page author-hosted journal article retrieved. Construction, component/properness argument, normalization discussion, Theorems 1.9 and 1.10, Remark 5.4, and Example 5.8 inspected. PDF pages 4 and 38 visually inspected.

sources.title: Jun-Muk Hwang and Hosung Kim, Varieties of minimal rational tangents on Veronese double cones
sources.inspection: Full 17-page journal PDF retrieved. Theorem 1.3, weighted-projection obstruction, general-point argument, Propositions 6.3 through 6.7, and final proof inspected. PDF pages 2 and 16 visually inspected.

sources.title: Jun-Muk Hwang and Ngaiming Mok, Birationality of the tangent map for minimal rational curves
sources.inspection: Full 15-page author-hosted text retrieved. Definition of minimal component, Theorem 1, Corollary 1 and the preceding finiteness and general-point smoothness statements inspected.

public_bibliographic_pages.result: Submission history begins 20 December 2012; version 2 submitted 9 January 2015. No claim to have inspected version 1.
Author publication list confirms IMRN 2015 no. 21, pages 10756–10800.

retrieval_notes: Direct journal PDF succeeded after the Hwang–Kim DOI landing page returned an internal error in the web reader.
An initial local download attempt using an unavailable optional Python module failed before any file was written; subsequent curl retrieval succeeded.
Hashes are of retrieved PDF bytes, not of rendered text or a claimed canonical journal edition.
Inspection was of the listed relevant passages; this record does not claim every proof in the papers was rederived.
